# MBecker Engineering

> Independent project, contract and claim management for large infrastructure projects, from Zurich, Switzerland. Owner: Michael Becker, M. Sc. C. Eng., Certified Senior Project Manager IAPM. This is a draft (preview) of a new website for mb-eng.ch; the official site is https://mb-eng.ch/.
